== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Orrimaarko (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-L-orrimaarko-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-78-Orrimaarko.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata), p. A-16 (PDF created by 27 August 2012), and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013), Light Side. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Once per game, may ▲ a rifle and/or an Interrupt with "scout" in game text. While alone at an exterior site, opponent's weapon destiny draws here are -2. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1230_77</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
